intro: About three-quarters of Mauritania is desert, with a long Atlantic coast.

chapters.title: Desert and coast
text: The Richat Structure, a giant circular rock formation about 40 km across, is visible from space. The Banc d'Arguin is one of the world's great bird habitats. The Senegal River forms the southern border.

chapters.title: Iron train
text: One of the world's longest trains carries iron ore 700 km from Zouérat to the coast.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Mauritania's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
